entities.summary: Frank Mantek is a German weightlifting coach and a retired weightlifter. He won a bronze medal at the 1980 Summer Olympics in the middle-heavyweight category, which also qualified as a bronze medal at world championships. In 1982 he won another combined bronze medal in the world/European championships.
